title: Standings and luck
intro: Records and the numbers behind them. Pythagorean wins come from points scored and allowed; EPA-expected wins add up each game's win chance given how efficiently each offense played (the better offense per play wins about 9 times in 10 when the gap is 0.15 EPA). Luck = actual wins minus expected: big positive numbers flag teams whose record flatters them, negative numbers teams better than their record. One-score games are decided by 8 points or fewer; fumble recovery share and opponents' field goal % are mostly luck and tend to even out.
